LanguageData.LP_Behir.label: behir
LanguageData.LP_Behir.description: A huge serpentine monster with blue scales and twelve legs, living in caves in high mountains and deserts. It is the sworn enemy of true dragons: when it smells a dragon it gives chase, breathes a line of lightning and swallows enemies whole.
LanguageData.LP_Behir.tools.0.label: bite
LanguageData.LP_Behir.tools.1.label: left front claw
LanguageData.LP_Behir.tools.2.label: right front claw
LanguageData.LP_Behir.tools.3.label: tail
LanguageData.LP_Beholder.label: beholder
LanguageData.LP_Beholder.description: A huge eyeball floating in midair, with a big mouth full of sharp teeth and ten eyestalks on top, each firing a different magic ray. Wherever its central eye looks, magic fails. Beholders are paranoid, greedy and hate everything that doesn't look like them, especially mind flayers.
LanguageData.LP_Beholder.tools.0.label: bite
LanguageData.LP_Demilich.label: demilich
LanguageData.LP_Demilich.description: A lich that has lived so long even its body has rotted away, leaving only a gem-studded skull floating in the air. Its howl can tear the souls from the living and suck them into the gems in its eye sockets.
LanguageData.LP_Demilich.tools.0.label: gnaw
